ktk.text: Jigme Village is where Kela and Dar Chensal are called to judge the theft of nine baskets of apples, and Dar lights the lamp of guilt, convicting Lotse Taring of the theft.
At the celebration Elder Ngabo tastes the apple soup, chokes and dies, and the villagers blame Lotse for poisoning her and storm the prison to kill him.
Kela leaps between Lotse and a warrior's sword and demands a trial, then escapes out a window pursued by Dar, until in the Combat of Clarity she defeats Dar and spares him.
Dar announces that Lotse will have a fair trial, and the girl from the tree rings the gong.
